scope: Accept sampled motion feedback in fleet and coastal scenarios. Not a certification of continuous smoothness, touch response, natural-looking foam or actual phone FPS.

hitFlash.evidence: Across both scenarios and profiles player turns white at0.1/0.2, normal by0.4; hull35→27 and return prompt appear. Flash remains clear over runway as well as ocean.

impactRecognition.evidence: Small orange impact at0.1/0.2 clearly differs from broad irregular yellow-orange fireball at1. At1.5 residual sparks/smoke replace core; no fire at2/3.

smokeFading.evidence: Trails follow turns; older parts thin and fade. Coast1.5 smoke cloud disperses by2 while trail extends behind plane.
smokeFading.weakness: Granular gray smoke still competes with water; continuous fade behavior between samples unverified.

wakeContinuity.evidence: Fleet wakes remain attached to carrier/escort sterns as world translates.

cameraMotion.evidence: Fleet initial catch-up and subsequent turn keep player central. Coast terrain scrolls consistently through turn with runway, rock rows and shoreline maintaining relative positions.
cameraMotion.weakness: Sparse samples cannot establish jitter-free continuous motion.

controlVisibility.evidence: Fixed HUD, heat, buttons and cyan ring remain readable in both scenarios; player stays trackable over runway, grass, shore and ocean.
controlVisibility.weakness: Ring remains coarse in fallback and prominent in empty space; does not isolate full silhouette during overlap. Fleet ship passes under Bomb at3 seconds. Coast wingman label reaches upper mission area at3 seconds. Touch not tested.

shorelineContinuity.evidence: Pale offshore strokes follow coast through scroll without a sampled detachment or large pop; shallow color band stays registered to land.
shorelineContinuity.weakness: Strokes look like dashed markings and remain similarly offset from shore; natural wave breaking/fading is not established from these samples.

regressionsAndLimits: No new sampled feedback failure observed.
Brighter ship surfaces do not hide player flash but reduce tonal distinction among small deck details.
Coastal foam is spatially stable in samples yet aesthetically artificial.
No timing-to-phone-FPS conversion or inference made.
priorities: Naturalize foam shapes and local beach-water interactions.
Replace repeated wake puffs; preserve smoke visibility over patterned water.
Test continuous motion and touch response separately.
